newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka midday stocks flat due to low liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka midday stocks flat due to low liquidity.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks barely moved in early Monday trade, as buyers were stymied by a lack of shares, brokers said.
The all share index was 0.56 points lower at 729.64 at midday. Turnover was 9.9 million rupees.
"Though buyers are in the market at current price, sellers are holding out for premiums," said a broker at John Keells.
Haycarb was up 10 percent at 99 rupees after a bonus announcement of one new share for every six held.
